//: Fallback pm2 process definition, used by deploy.sh only when pm2 has no
process registered under PM2_NAME and there is no ecosystem.config.js on
the server. The live box has ecosystem.config.js, which wins.
This mirrors how the live process is actually configured: pm2 runs app.py
directly through the virtualenv python, and app.py's __main__ block calls
uvicorn.run() itself. Host and port therefore come from .env (PORT, default
'interpreter' must point at the virtualenv python. Without it pm2 assumes
node and the process dies instantly with a syntax error.
